card.name: The word case after "In"
card.fires_on: The word "case" right after a capitalized or lowercase "In", forming "In case of" or "in case". Seen most in overdose instructions, also in casual web text.

modes.label: Overdose instructions
modes.description: "In case of overdose" in warning sections of drug labels.
modes.example: KEEP OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN . In<< case>> of overdose (or accidental ingestion) get

modes.label: Casual or conditional use
modes.description: "In case you..." in blog or web text, or "in case" within clinical advice.
modes.example: Finally, she was able to write the letter A on her own. In<< case>> you are wondering, she is 3

card.plain: It lights up on the word "case" in the phrase "in case", most often in "In case of overdose".
